claim_ceiling: Conditional obstruction candidate only for a universal exact arbitrary-deck generic Query2P1 object whose one-deck restriction transcript also remains correct across the declared correlated public target shifts, with target-independent serialized advice and complete MPZ accounting. It is not the previously reviewed fixed-target one-restriction theorem, a P1553 or coordinate-deck result, a generic ECDLP lower bound, an attack, speedup, SOTA movement, B71, closure, completion, or breakthrough.

controls.name: fixed-target-only object
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: The accepted fixed-target contract alone determines the shifted boundary and residual.
controls.construction: Use an object exact for R and the F0 restriction path, but with no contract for R+[m t]P when t>0; an admissible extension returns true at every unsupported shifted target.
controls.observed_failure_signature: Only q(0) is supported. The all-true extension has no first-false index and does not determine z.

controls.name: zero restricted decks
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: The same boundary decoder works while all five decks remain full.
controls.construction: Let T=m+m^2+m^3+m^4+m^5. The five full decks have scalar sumset [-T,T].
derivation: m=2^ceil(log2 B) is at least B=N^(1/5)
m^5 is at least N, so T is at least N
[-T,T] contains an integer representative of every residue modulo N
every shifted membership predicate is true
controls.observed_failure_signature: There is no false endpoint or first-false index.
first_missing_premises: a residual interval shorter than the modulus

controls.name: marginal per-query success
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: High success for every shifted call separately implies a successful adaptive transcript.
controls.construction: For h required shifted calls, sample a hidden failure index J uniformly from {1,...,h}; call i is correct exactly when J is not i.
derivation: The intersection of all h correctness events is empty
Therefore no complete decoder-success event follows from the marginals
controls.observed_failure_signature: Every marginal can approach one while joint transcript success is zero.
first_missing_premises: A5 single joint success event over the actual adaptive path
controls.effect_on_exact_claim: none because the claim states the joint event

controls.name: N<=4L+1 modular-wrap stratum
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: The one-switch predicate q(t) holds uniformly after dropping the strict no-wrap assumption.
controls.construction: Split the excluded stratum at N=2L+1.
derivation: If N<=2L+1, [-L,L] contains at least N consecutive integers and hence every residue, so q(t)=true for all t.
If 2L+1<N<=4L+1, choose z=L and t_star=N-2L; then 2<=t_star<=2L+1.
For that z, q(1)=false because L+1 has not wrapped into [-L,L].
But L+t_star=N-L is congruent to -L, so q(t_star)=true.
At N=4L+1, t_star=2L+1, so the claimed false endpoint itself aliases -L.
Concrete linked instance: N=10009 is prime, m=8, L=4680, 2L+1=9361, 4L+1=18721, and t_star=649; exact modular membership gives q(1)=false and q(649)=true.
controls.observed_failure_signature: The predicate is constant true or changes false-to-true after the nominal boundary.
controls.effect_on_exact_claim: none because the entire stratum is excluded

controls.name: random-only deck promise
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: Correctness for randomly sampled decks covers the deterministic mixed-radix decks and their adaptive dyadic restrictions.
controls.construction: Use an object whose promise and correctness hold only when all decks are sampled from its declared random distribution and which refuses the structured F_i family.
controls.observed_failure_signature: The very first deterministic mixed-radix query is outside the promise.

controls.name: coordinate-aware P1553 object
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: An ordinary-generic arbitrary-deck obstruction automatically applies to P1553 coordinate-aware or target-local objects.
controls.construction: Use an object whose predicates, state, or transducers depend on point coordinates or another representation-specific relation absent from the ordinary generic encoding interface.
controls.observed_failure_signature: No type-preserving map supplies the required arbitrary labelled F_i decks, target-independent object, or exact shifted generic membership predicate.
first_missing_premises: a separate P1553 or coordinate reduction

controls.name: target-conditioned advice
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: The target-independent preprocessing consequence applies unchanged when advice may depend on Q or on each R_t.
controls.construction: Allow advice to be regenerated or selected after the target is known, including advice that carries target-specific residual information not charged to the online transcript.
controls.observed_failure_signature: The advice is not one serialized object fixed before fresh Q, and the declared MPZ model boundary cannot be invoked.

controls.name: extra-oracle object
controls.known_false_scope_inflation: The ordinary-generic conditional obstruction also rules out objects with an uncharged discrete-log, coordinate, or equivalent oracle.
controls.construction: Add an oracle that returns x from Q, or an equivalent target-specific separator, without counting that oracle in ell or k.
controls.observed_failure_signature: The object recovers x with constant success, but it is outside the ordinary-generic interface and its decisive interaction is absent from the ledger.

admitted_only_if_all_hold: one target-independent serialized object fixed before fresh Q
one jointly correct adaptive transcript over every selected correlated target
unaffected_routes: marginal guarantees with separately proved joint amplification

verdict_scope: The producer's scope and first-missing-premise boundaries survive all eight J3 controls. No J1, J2, blind-rederivation, whole-claim, Pareto, or scientific-state verdict is issued.
